name: Crustdata company export
description: Company export from app.crustdata.com (Data Export, CSV). Built from LinkedIn company pages: name, website, headcount and its 6-month growth, headquarters as 'Town, State, Country'. No street, ZIP or contacts. Only Arizona rows are kept; town and state come from the headquarters column and the date is the import day. call-this-week gives a listed business the hiring boost when its headcount grew.
